_comment: LL-08 interest-drift router, learning-mode routing, and future-path thresholds. Shared by services/event-tracker (python) and frontend/src/learning (js). No magic numbers in code — every threshold lives here. Companion to config/delivery_dial.json (LL-04).

signal_weights._comment: relative pull of each telemetry source on the rolling interest profile

change_point._comment: windowed share-shift detector: compare mean share over the recent buckets against the baseline buckets. bucket_seconds=86400 -> daily buckets.

goal_protection._comment: Non-negotiable #5: the stated goal is the main path. Drift NEVER auto-changes it; a goal change requires an explicit ask (the one place we DO ask).
goal_protection.goal_change_question: You set {goal} as your goal, but recent sessions lean towards {drift_domain}. Do you want to keep {goal} as the main line and take {drift_domain} as a side quest, or switch your stated goal?

mode_routing._comment: One skill, many doors. Every mode terminates at the SAME LL-05 verification endpoint.

descriptions.project_together: build a real artifact side-by-side; curriculum derived backwards from the project

mode_routing.verification_note: LL-05 owns this endpoint. All four modes POST here; no mode has its own verification path.
